page.overview:
Who is Janine?

Janine is Koga's daughter and is the Gym Leader who succeeded/replaced him in Gold, Silver, Crystal and HeartGold and SoulSilver. She both runs the Fuchsia City Gym, and as well as specializing in using -type Pokémon just as her father did in the Kanto based games. She will award the player the Soul Badge and TM84, TM06 in Gen. II, if you defeat her.

Janine is a pale young woman with purple eyes and purplish hair, the latter being tied into spike ponytail by a yellow band. She wears a scarf, a belt and white socks.

Janine wears a black shirt and dark pants. She also has some black gear equipped on her hands and legs.

Her outfit in Crystal is the same as it is in Gold and Silver.
